 # Install and join an edge
 
-On a clean macOS or Linux machine, run the source installer:
+Joining a center takes two steps: install the desktop app, then finish joining with the invitation link. Everything
+runs in the GUI; the source checkout and the `ha edge join` command remain as a fallback at the end of this page.
+
+## 1. Install the desktop app
+
+Download a package from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything/releases):
+
+- macOS (Apple silicon): a signed and notarized `dmg` or `zip`. Open the `dmg` and drag **Harness Anything** into
+  Applications.
+- Windows: x64 NSIS installer; SmartScreen may appear on first run.
+- Linux: x64 AppImage or deb.
+
+The app ships its own runtime, so Node.js and Git are not required. See [Install](01-install.md) for details.
+
+On macOS, launching the app before it has been moved into Applications shows a dialog that offers to move it there;
+accepting the prompt moves it automatically, and declining still lets you continue for that session.
+
+## 2. Admin: issue a one-time invitation
+
+In the center GUI, open **Settings → Repos & connections → Center node** and use the **Invite an edge node** panel:
+
+1. Under **Member**, pick an existing member or choose **New member…** and fill in the username, email, and display
+   name; optionally set an **Edge node label (optional)**.
+2. Tick the **Repositories** and **Permission groups** to grant.
+3. Click **Issue invitation**. The one-time link is shown once: click **Copy link** and send it to that person over a
+   separate channel (chat or email); after **Done** the link cannot be retrieved again.
+
+The invitation expires after 72 hours and can be consumed once. The **Invitation audit** list shows each invitation as
+Pending / Consumed / Expired / Revoked, and a pending invitation can be withdrawn with **Revoke**. Do not post the link
+publicly.
+
+## 3. Join from the invitation link
+
+Either way works:
+
+- Click the `harness-edge://join/…` link in the invitation message; the app opens with the link pre-filled, or
+- Open the app, click **Join a center** on the home page (the empty state before any project exists) or in the top-left
+  project switcher, and paste the invitation link into the **Invitation link** field.
+
+Click **Start joining**. The link stays on this machine and is never uploaded or logged; the invitation link already
+carries the trust information, so no manual configuration is needed.
+
+## 4. Device sign-in in the browser
+
+The wizard shows the **Sign-in address** and the **Code**:
+
+1. Click **Open in browser** (or open the address manually), enter the code in the browser, and approve the sign-in;
+   **Copy the code** copies it to the clipboard.
+2. While waiting, the app shows “Waiting for approval…”; it continues on its own once approved. **Cancel sign-in**
+   returns to the previous step.
+
+If the sign-in service is unreachable, the app says so and retries automatically.
+
+## 5. First sync
+
+The wizard walks each invited repository through Preparing workspace → Registering repository → First sync → Synced.
+When it finishes you see “Joined; switched to the first joined repository.”; if some repositories fail you see
+“Some repositories did not sync; retry later or contact your inviter.”, and the failed rows list the reason.
+
+## 6. When something goes wrong
+
+The wizard pairs every failure with a suggested next step. Common cases:
+
+| What the app shows | What to do |
+| --- | --- |
+| The invitation link is invalid or damaged. | Ask your inviter for a fresh link and try again. |
+| The invitation has expired. | Ask your inviter to issue a new invitation. |
+| The invitation was already used; a one-time link cannot join twice. | Ask your inviter to issue a new invitation. |
+| The invitation was revoked. | Ask your inviter to issue a new invitation. |
+| The center's certificate fingerprint does not match the invitation. | Confirm the link came from a trusted administrator; if the certificate really rotated, ask for a new invitation. |
+| The signed-in account does not match the invited person. | Sign in as the invited person, or ask for an invitation for the account you use. |
+| The permissions captured with the invitation have changed. | Ask your inviter to reissue against the current permissions. |
+| This app version differs from the center; the handshake was refused. | Upgrade the app to the same version as the center and retry. |
+| The device sign-in timed out before approval. | Start over and complete the browser sign-in in time. |
+| The sign-in service is unreachable. | Check the network and retry; contact the center administrator if it persists. |
+| The sign-in service refused this device login. | Start over; contact the center administrator if it persists. |
+| Joining failed; the center or sign-in service returned an error. | The app also shows the center's original explanation; follow it or contact your inviter. |
+

 # 安装并加入边缘节点
 
-在干净的 macOS 或 Linux 机器上准备 Git、Node.js 24+ 与 curl，再运行源码安装命令：
+受邀加入一个中心只需要两步：安装桌面 App，再用邀请链接完成加入。全程使用 GUI，不需要命令行；源码安装与 `ha edge join` 命令保留为备选，见文末。
+
+## 1. 安装桌面 App
+
+从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/FairladyZ625/harness-anything/releases) 下载安装包：
+
+- macOS（Apple Silicon）：已签名并公证的 `dmg` 或 `zip`。打开 `dmg`，把 **Harness Anything** 拖进「应用程序」。
+- Windows：x64 NSIS 安装器，首次运行可能出现 SmartScreen 提示。
+- Linux：x64 AppImage 或 deb。
+
+App 自带运行时，不需要另装 Node.js 或 Git。更多安装细节见[安装](01-install.md)。
+
+在 macOS 上，如果直接运行了还没有拖进「应用程序」的 App，它会弹窗询问是否移动到「应用程序」目录：点 **移动到「应用程序」** 即可自动完成移动；选 **以后再说** 也能继续使用，但建议放入「应用程序」。
+
+## 2. 管理员：签发一次性邀请
+
+在中心 GUI 打开「设置 → 仓库与连接 → 中心节点」，在「邀请边缘节点」面板：
+
+1. 在「成员」中选择已有成员，或选「新成员…」并填写用户名、邮箱与显示名称；可再填「边缘节点名称（可选）」。
+2. 勾选要授予的「仓库」与「权限组」。
+3. 点 **签发邀请**。一次性链接只显示一次：点 **复制链接**，通过独立渠道（如聊天软件、邮件）发给对方；点 **完成** 后链接无法再取出。
+
+邀请有效期为 72 小时，只能消费一次。「邀请审计」列表显示每条邀请的状态（待消费 / 已消费 / 已过期 / 已撤销），待消费的邀请可以点 **撤销** 作废。不要公开发布邀请链接。
+
+## 3. 成员：打开邀请链接加入
+
+两种方式任选：
+
+- 直接点邀请消息里的 `harness-edge://join/…` 链接，App 会自动打开并预填链接；或
+- 打开 App，在首页（还没有项目时的空状态）或左上角项目切换器里点 **加入中心**，把邀请链接粘贴进「邀请链接」输入框。
+
+点 **开始加入**。链接只在本机使用，不会被上传或记录；邀请链接已包含所需的信任信息，无需手工配置。
+
+## 4. 浏览器设备登录
+
+向导显示「登录网址」与「验证码」：
+
+1. 点 **在浏览器打开**（或手动打开该网址），在浏览器里输入验证码并批准登录；**复制验证码** 可一键复制。
+2. 等待期间 App 显示「等待批准…」，批准后自动继续，不需要手动刷新；**取消登录** 可返回上一步。
+
+登录服务暂时不可达时 App 会提示并自动重试。
+
+## 5. 首次同步
+
+App 为邀请的每个仓库依次显示：准备工作区 → 注册仓库 → 首次同步中 → 已同步。完成后显示「加入完成，已切换到第一个加入的仓库。」；个别仓库失败时显示「部分仓库未同步成功，可稍后重试或联系邀请人。」，失败仓库会在列表里给出原因。
+
+## 6. 出错了怎么办
+
+向导会把失败原因和下一步一起显示。常见情形对照：
+
+| App 显示 | 怎么办 |
+| --- | --- |
+| 邀请链接无效或已损坏。 | 请向邀请人重新获取链接后再试。 |
+| 邀请已过期。 | 请邀请人重新签发一份邀请。 |
+| 邀请已被使用，一次性链接不能重复加入。 | 请邀请人重新签发一份邀请。 |
+| 邀请已被撤销。 | 请邀请人重新签发一份邀请。 |

@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+# Fixed daemon releases
+
+Development builds and production must use separate executable trees and daemon state roots. Keep production ledger data in its existing location; installing a release does not move or initialize data.
+
+The release installer uses independent version directories and an atomically replaced `current` link. This follows the generation model described in [Nix profiles](https://nix.dev/manual/nix/2.28/package-management/profiles.html). Dependencies use the lockfile through [npm ci](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-ci/). No Nix installation is required. These tools target macOS and Linux.
+
+## Install and switch
+
+Run from an operator shell with Node 24+, npm, Git and the native build tools required by node-pty. Choose an installation root outside every development checkout. The following variables are operator-selected paths, and `CANDIDATE` is the full commit that passed release qualification:
+
+```sh
+node tools/release-installation.mjs install \
+  --root "$INSTALL_ROOT" --repository "$PUBLIC_CHECKOUT" --revision "$CANDIDATE"
+node tools/release-installation.mjs switch \
+  --root "$INSTALL_ROOT" --revision "$CANDIDATE" \
+  --user-root "$STATE_ROOT" --daemon-id "$DAEMON_ID" --workspace "$LEDGER_CHECKOUT"
+```
+
+Install creates `versions/<commit>` without starting or stopping a process. It refuses to overwrite an installed version. Dependencies and workspace links belong to that installation. After compiling, npm rebuilds the CLI/daemon bin links using its [documented bin-link step](https://docs.npmjs.com/cli/v11/commands/npm-rebuild/) without rerunning lifecycle scripts. A failed install leaves its `.install-*` directory for diagnosis and does not change the active release.
+
+Switch stops the current release using that release's CLI, records the previous version, changes `current`, and starts the candidate using its own CLI. A refused handshake, incomplete drain, failed launch or unattached repository is an error. A failed candidate remains recorded so the recovery command can stop it using its own binary.
+
+For the first migration from a development checkout, first stop the old daemon using the old CLI. A first switch refuses any live unmanaged daemon with `daemon_unmanaged`, including one built from the same commit; it leaves the active pointer and deployment state untouched. Preserve its original entry path for recovery: there is no previous installed release yet. If a service manager owns the daemon, an operator must first change its entry to the installation's `current` daemon path. These tools do not install services or change shell configuration.
+
+Use the CLI at `$INSTALL_ROOT/current/node_modules/.bin/ha` for daily commands. Workers receive the CLI from the daemon's own installation. Online hello accepts the current protocol minor and its immediate predecessor within the same major. Build commits are diagnostic metadata, so existing workers keep their original CLI, relay and credentials across a compatible release switch. The server replies with the admitted protocol version. A protocol outside that window returns `incompatible_protocol_version`: use the release CLI or an isolated development/test daemon. Refused hello never sends the business request, including shutdown, and cannot fall back to signals or a stopped marker. Internal APIs have no compatibility adapters; a protocol bump retires the older minor automatically.
+
+## Roll back
+
+```sh
+node tools/release-installation.mjs rollback \
+  --root "$INSTALL_ROOT" --user-root "$STATE_ROOT" \
+  --daemon-id "$DAEMON_ID" --workspace "$LEDGER_CHECKOUT"
+node tools/release-installation.mjs status --root "$INSTALL_ROOT"
+```
+
+Rollback uses the same stop/start/readiness path. It refuses when no previous release exists. Recovery of ledger data is separate: take and test a consistent backup before upgrading. An executable rollback cannot undo an incompatible data change.
+
+A deployment lock belongs to one installer process; the updater has its own `.main-update-lock` with the same crash-recovery rule. After a crash, inspect the PID in `.deployment-lock`, prove the process has exited, and remove that lock explicitly before retrying. Preserve failed-release logs and directories. Never rebuild an installed version in place.
+
+## Test center updates
+
+Create a dedicated synthetic ledger and user root using the normal product initialization and login flow. Do not copy a production ledger, token or credentials. Allocate the test center's existing approved listener before connecting edges.
+
+The one-shot updater fetches public `origin/main`, resolves the commit, and invokes the same install/switch path:
